create_2d_sincos_pos_embed: create a 2D sinusoidal positional embedding from grid size and embedding dimension
build_1d_sincos_pos_embed: build a 1D sinusoidal positional embedding from positions and embedding dimension
generate_2d_coord_embedding: generate a 2D sine-cosine positional embedding from batched xy coordinates
sample_features_bilinear: sample spatial features from a 4D tensor at given 2D coordinates using bilinear interpolation
sample_tensor_coords: sample values from a 2D or 3D tensor at continuous coordinates with bilinear interpolation
